title: docs(spec): say a disabled package's fields are not among a base's contributions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKB8Sg6c6sVpL96ruVvdxaf)_

Fixes #30086

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：包定制读取接口（`GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations`）里"其他包贡献的条目"那一段的说明文字，补上一句：被停用的包加到对象上的字段不会列出。
2. 为什么改：服务端早已不再列出、也不再展示这些字段（#30362 已落地），可说明文字还写着"来自任何其他包的字段都会列出"，作者和 AI 读规格时会以为停用后字段仍在。
3. 风险与回滚：只改说明文字和由它生成的参考文档页，接口形状、键、默认值、导出都不变；回滚即还原这一个提交。
4. 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` 的 `contributions` 数组 describe（字段分句新增的括号说明），其次是重新生成的 `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` 同一行。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`，预期输出 "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`: the `.describe()` of `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema.contributions`. Its field clause, "the fields of every object extension of an object the base owns, from any package but the base and its pair", now ends with "(a disabled package's are not listed, as the served object withholds them)", in the same parenthetical form the flow and navigation clauses already carry.
- `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx`: regenerated by `gen:docs`. Not hand-edited.
- `.changeset/30086-customizations-disabled-package-fields.md`: a `@objectstack/spec` patch.

No key, shape, export, default or test assertion changes, and nothing in `packages/runtime` or `packages/objectql` changes.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts src/api/package-api.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 155 passed (155).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 1 before `gen:docs` (only `content/docs/references/**` stale), then exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise moved, and the residue is what this PR fixes.** At `origin/main` `dc518112`, PR #30362 (`8cc709d5`, an ancestor of this branch's base, `merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0) already makes the served object's fold withhold a disabled package's `objectExtensions` fields (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, the `isPackageDisabled` filters at :4883 and :4912). `readBaseContributions` skips that package's `field` contributors (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` :3386, docblock :3320-3326). So reading (b) of the card governs, no server work is owed, and the schema docblock "a disabled package's contributions MUST NOT be listed" (:511-514) is now true for every kind and stays as written.
- **The runtime behaviour is pinned.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts` :326, "no longer lists the module's fields among the app's contributions", drives the real `GET /packages/:app/customizations` route after `PATCH /packages/:module/disable`, and :336 restores them on enable. The nav half is pinned in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-customizations.test.ts` :693.
- **The `field` / `flow` arm describes are unchanged.** They define what a `field` or `flow` entry IS, not which items are listed, so neither reads as including a disabled package's fields; the listing rule lives in the array describe.
- **Changeset classification.** `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`: the text now matches what the server already answers, and no metadata author's accepted set moves. `check-changeset-no-major` measured below.

## Verification

All readings at head `b5aa7aa15` (base `dc518112`, `objectstack-ai/objectstack`).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 96 derived commands, every one run with its exit code captured before any pipe; all 96 exit 0. Six (`@objectstack/lint` `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture`, spec `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) first answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (unbuilt packages); after a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (119/119 tasks) they were re-run and exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a DERIVED zero: all 96 recorded an exit code).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event` (this body as the declaration): exit 0, "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `no` and metadata-protocol `none` ... a non-protocol change at `patch`".
- Local-only: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exit 0; `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
- The derivation flagged one upstream gate file changed since the base (`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`, two lines adding a `packages/rest` roster row); it does not read these paths, so the branch was not re-merged.
